running-time.purpose: The time inside the running ring; the ring decides its size (scales to 0.4, or 0.3 with Done).

complete-total.purpose: The total inside the complete ring on both complete screens, scaled to the ring (down to 0.3, or 0.2 in Open Rounds' 180pt ring).

running-count.purpose: The Rounds count under the running ring.

hollow-word.purpose: A setup row's outlined Phase name; scales to 0.5 to fit beside the digits.

running-phase.purpose: The Phase name at the top of the running screen, in its ring color.

wheel-digits.purpose: The value sheet's digit wheels and colon.

running-caption.purpose: The caption beside the running count, at 0.72 opacity.

headline.purpose: Labels of the amber capsules: Start, Close, Confirm, Make Plan.

title.purpose: The complete recap, and the Round count (secondary gray) on Open Rounds' complete screen.

setup-caption.purpose: The secondary-gray caption under a setup row's digits.

label.purpose: The note above Start, the Health line, Preset summaries.

motion.name: complete-ring-close
motion.purpose: The complete ring draws closed once as the complete screen appears; the success haptic plays when the animation completes. Under Reduce Motion it is shown closed and the haptic plays at once.

motion.name: wheel-fade
motion.value: opacity 1 to 0.15, scale 1 to 0.65 with distance from center
motion.purpose: Digit wheel rows fade and shrink away from the selected row; selection haptic on change.

rings.name: running
rings.purpose: The running Time Ring; Phase track under Phase ring, round caps.

rings.name: complete
rings.purpose: The complete ring on the Plan complete screen, 160 to 300pt wide.

rings.name: rounds-complete
rings.purpose: Open Rounds' complete ring, fixed at 180 x 180pt, around the total.

rings.name: fallback
rings.purpose: With no known last Phase (rare; the app falls back to the final Phase), the complete ring is secondary-gray over ink-separator, never amber.

hollowWord.construction: 12 copies of the word in the ring color offset 1pt around a circle, the ground color on top, composited, then one opacity

liquidGlass.uses: Pause/Resume and Stop, in one GlassEffectContainer

dynamicTypeCaps.element: Amber bottom-bar buttons (Start, Close, Confirm, Make Plan)

narrative.overview:
Temper is dark ink with four Phase colors laid on it. Setup is the Workout written in those colors before Start: one row per Phase in the order it runs, a big hollow word in the Phase's ring color at the left, large tabular digits at the right, rows split by hairlines. Starting turns the whole screen into the current Phase's field, with its name at the top, a ring and the time in the middle, and the controls at the foot. When the Workout ends, the complete screen closes that ring in the last Phase's color around the total.

Everything else is native iOS 27 recolored onto the ink: the Liquid Glass tab bar and buttons, navigation, menus, sheets and grouped lists. The app is dark only; there is no light variant. Every color has an Increase Contrast value, listed in the sidecar. SF Rounded is set once at the root and used everywhere.

Scope: this records the iPhone app. The Apple Watch app and the Live Activity draw from the same `InkColors` and `PhaseColors` in `Shared/Ink.swift`; the Watch also uses `StopColors` for its Stop.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink ground, raised rows one step lighter, hairline separators.
Amber marks the action to take and nothing else.
Each Phase has a field, ring, track and text color; a Phase is recognised by its field from across a room.
Setup labels are hollow words in the Phase's ring color; digits are large, semibold and tabular.
Liquid Glass for buttons: prominent amber for the primary action, plain glass for the running controls.
One motion: the complete ring draws closed once, with a success haptic when it closes.

rules.name: The Amber Means Act Rule
rules.body: Amber is the action to take here and nothing else. A label, a count or a decoration is never amber; Rounds' hollow word is secondary gray for this reason.

rules.name: The Phase Is the Field Rule
rules.body: On the running screen the whole background is the Phase's field, and its name and ring are in the Phase's ring color. A value sheet opened from a Phase row takes that Phase's field, ring, track and text.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Every color has an Increase Contrast value in `Shared/Ink.swift`. A new color without one doesn't ship.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number Temper shows uses tabular figures, so a counting time never jitters.

rules.name: The Ring Decides Rule
rules.body: The running time and the complete total are set above any phone's width and scale down to fit their ring. Size the ring, not the text.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow of its own. If something needs to stand out, it gets a tone step or Liquid Glass, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Hollow Word Rule
rules.body: A setup row's Phase name is an outlined word: the word in the Phase's ring color, offset 1 pt in twelve directions, with the ground color on top, then one opacity over the whole: 0.62 for a Phase and 0.72 for Rounds, or 0.8 and 0.85 with Increase Contrast. That keeps it a backdrop that still reads at about 4.5:1 (8:1 with Increase Contrast).

dos: Do keep amber for the action to take on the screen: one prominent amber capsule in the bottom bar.
Do put a Phase's name in its ring color, on setup, on Describe, in the recap and on the running screen.
Do use tabular figures for every number, and fixed sizes that scale down for anything read at a distance.
Do give every new color an Increase Contrast value in `Shared/Ink.swift`.
Do cap Dynamic Type on bottom-bar buttons and running controls at XXX Large so they can't crowd the iPhone SE.
Do show the complete ring closed, without animation, under Reduce Motion.
donts: Don't color Rounds, a label or a decoration amber.
Don't show a total on Start when the Workout waits for Done.
Don't call the complete screen's action Done; it is Close.
Don't add custom shadows, gradients or tinted glass panes; depth is tone and native Liquid Glass.
Don't add a light variant; the app is dark only.
